coverage.gr_equiv: no stock GR block; LZ4 does not specify WHICH block a compressor must emit, so the gate is decode(encode(x)) == x under the published golden AND under the INDEPENDENT reference C decoder (lz4.block)
coverage.patterns: 12 payload classes at the model level, all round-tripping under both decoders; 2 of them on the AUTO-PLACED + ROUTED + BUILT design on a real simkyt chip through a real SramPanelDevice
coverage.independent_decoder: lz4.block (the reference C implementation, via its Python binding, run in the GNU-Radio interpreter)

open_gap.what: payloads that ENTER THE SCAN LOOP emit nothing on chip; payloads shorter than MF_LIMIT (12) take the literals-only tail and are byte-exact
open_gap.measured: 2/3/5/8 bytes match the model exactly; 24/30/40 bytes give zero output and stop_reason EventLimit after ~1.3M events
open_gap.cause: the 14-cell fold closed into a 12-cell RING, so an adjacent-cell hand-off can cost 11 hops the long way round and each word occupies most of the ring for its flight; every edge IS reachable, the hops are just long (INV-51 clause 1)
open_gap.layer: block FOLD — fixable, not a substrate or ISA wall
open_gap.next: re-fold as a SERPENTINE; add a max-hop term to the fold score, which forbids a ring by construction
